capacity.rule: Transfer the approved S1 scene-edge capacity value 1 to this exact bounded local edge set. Destination position capacity remains the exact authored value 1; capacity does not imply occupancy, vacancy, throughput beyond the edge contract, or historical fact.

canonical_capacity_boundary.runtime_rule: Read committed placement occupancy. If a destination position has no remaining capacity, keep the move unavailable and report the existing typed capacity result; do not inflate template capacity or assume vacancy.

typed_gap.scope: exact canonical south-approach G4@1 only; do not infer fixed NPC count or occupancy
